notes:
Account snapshot / recent activity:
- Company: ClarityHarbor Insights (mid-market B2B SaaS; product: customer success analytics + recommendations).
- Primary contact: CTO -> Elena Morales; Product lead: Samir Khan. AE owner Jordan Li, SE Priya K. CSM Miguel for renewal planning.
- Why Redwood: wants a single API for embeddings + search, clear perf/cost tradeoffs; likely to start hosted then reserve Dedicated if perf/cost promising.
- Use-case specifics:
  * Nightly batch reindex: ~4–6M documents initially, expected to grow ~30%/yr; doc avg size ~1.2KB; target vector store: uses Pinecone currently but open to switching / hybrid.
  * Real-time product search and recommendations: ~300 QPS peak (read-heavy), 60k embedding ops/day baseline, burst to 150k/day during campaigns.
  * Embedding dims: standard 1536 preferred (compatibility w/ current pipeline), evaluating 1024->1536 tradeoffs.
  * Latency SLOs: tail P95 search under 250ms (end-to-end), embedding generation <120ms for real-time flows. Batch ingestion can be >1hr for 5M docs overnight.
- POC summary (hosted API):
  * 2026-02-11: kickoff call (ff_20260211_3829). Ran initial hosted embedding throughput test: single-hosted endpoint sustained 40 EPS with p95=115ms for 1536-dim model.
  * 2026-02-18: batch ingest test via hosted API + local vector DB (Milvus): 1.2M docs / hour observed when using parallel workers (8 workers), network bottleneck; suggestion: use Dedicated or colocated vector DB to reduce network egress.
  * 2026-02-25: demo of streaming rerank + semantic search (ff_20260225_4410). SE showed prefix/KV cache idea to reduce repeated embedding calls for similar queries.
- Technical asks & constraints heard from CTO: "We need predictable unit economics — not surprised by spikes." Wants SSO + audit logs + KMS for keys. Data residency for EU customers (multi-region requirement).
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market procurement; wants a clear hosted burn estimate and a Dedicated baseline (reserved GPUs) that pays off after 6–9 months given their volume.
- Integration notes: current stack uses Airflow for nightly ETL, Postgres for metadata, Pinecone as vector store. Team asked about Redwood SDK hooks for batch jobs and direct connector to vector DBs (push vs pull).
- Risks: legal DPA negotiation on KMS + key escrow; engineering team overloaded — ingestion pipeline needs sharding + idempotency before full POC.
- Quotes & paraphrases:
  * Elena (CTO) "If Dedicated halves our per-embed cost for steady-state, we migrate — but need clear SLA and rollback plan."
  * Samir (product) "Search quality regressions are major risk; will want eval harness tied to our tests."
- Recent actions / next steps (chopped):
  * SE to deliver perf matrix (hosted vs small Dedicated vs 2xDedicated) by 2026-03-12.
  * AE to submit draft Dedicated pricing sheet + run internal margin check for estimated ARR by 2026-03-15.
  * Customer legal to share redlines on DPA by 2026-03-20.
  * Engineering: provide production ETL job sample (Airflow DAG) to Redwood SE for advice on parallelization and best batching config.
- Staging notes: recommend a two-phase POC: (1) Hosted perf & integration (3 weeks), (2) Short Dedicated trial (2–4 weeks) with colocated vector DB and autoscaling off to measure cost.
- CRM style: short, choppy follow-ups in thread. Priorities: throughput, cost per embed, vector DB connector, security (KMS/SAML).
- Attachments & refs: pricing deck draft (drive:/Sales/ClarityHarbor/Redwood-Pricing-Draft-v1.pptx), security FAQ (drive:/Security/ClarityHarbor/Security-FAQ-Redwood-2026-02.docx).
- Low-level notes: tried Pinecone upsert parallelism=16, hit TCP timeout at 10k/s sustained; Milvus local worker parallelism scaled better. SE suggestion: tune batch size to 512 vectors, use gzip compression on transport.
- Decision criteria from buyer: 1) predictable $/embed in steady-state 2) P95 end-to-end latency under 250ms for search 3) SOC2 + SSO + KMS + EU residency support 4) simple migration path off-hosted.
- Internal tags: prob won if Dedicated baseline shows >40% cost reduction over hosted at their volumes and legal signs DPA.
short_description: Mid-market SaaS (customer success analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + semantic search, running POC now; likely to move to Dedicated if cost & SLA justify. Focus: throughput, vector DB integration, batch jobs, security requirements.
